correctness.rationale: For every finite \(n\ge2\) and real \(q>0\), the insertion-rank bijection gives independent \(U_t\) with mass \(q^{t-r}/[t]_q\). Record \(R_j\) is the event \(U_j=j\) and descent \(D_i\) is \(U_{i+1}\le U_i\). Distinct coordinates prove exact zeros; the two conditional cases give the stated rational entries and signs; the algebraic row identity is exact and the \(q=1\) telescoping endpoint is verified. Exact rational enumeration replays all \(2\le n\le7\) at \(q\in\{1/2,1,2\}\) from standalone verify.py. Finite experiments are corroboration, not the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The new claim determines the entire position-by-position upper-record/descent cross-covariance at every positive Mallows inversion parameter and proves strict aggregate negativity with a finite q-harmonic expression. Open primary full texts establish independent insertion ranks, global Stirling–Eulerian joint counts, and different inversion/fixed-point descent covariance laws, but none inspected states or directly implies the exact record–descent matrix without an additional prefix-rank calculation. The uniform aggregate can be derived from older count generating functions, so it is explicitly presented only as a corollary, not a stand-alone originality assertion. Residual equivalence risk remains.
residual_risks: The literature of joint record and Eulerian statistics is broad, and an equivalent positional covariance identity may exist under another name.

Gessel-type basic decompositions and general q-exchangeability could provide an alternate derivation; this result is an explicit local covariance classification, not a claim to new generic rank insertion or exchangeability machinery.
Online database and publisher holdings were not exhaustively searched.

value.rationale: The record and adjacent-descent indicators are canonical statistics in random rankings. The full signed bipartite covariance geometry is a natural complete local classification and distinguishes off-band zero dependence from opposite-sign adjacent interactions. Its exact row cancellation implies strict negativity of global record–descent covariance uniformly in n and q, calibrating joint permutation tests; this positional information is not obtained from the usual univariate Eulerian and Stirling marginals or aggregate count identities.
